rightsVerified: receipt item key/path/text/audio hashes match the canonical release asset
receipt provider/voice/language/generator metadata matches narration state
allowed rights claim with durable evidence references

legacyPolicy: Existing narration without contemporaneous generation receipts remains unverified. Do not create retrospective receipts merely to raise release coverage.
driftPolicy: Text, audio, receipt, provider metadata, rights claim, or rights evidence drift revokes generated narration provenance until a new valid receipt is imported.
importMode: dry-run by default; explicit --write required to mutate content/narration-state.json
